cases.text:

Viele Grüße
Lena

sisi ni watatu na tungependa kutembelea shamba lako la kahawa asubuhi ya Jumamosi. Inawezekana?

Hello Noor,

cases.text:
Dear Noor,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Priya and I'm writing from Bangalore. My husband and I visited a tea estate in Munnar last year and loved it so much that we promised ourselves we would see a coffee farm on our next big trip, and a friend who stayed in Moshi in 2024 told us your tour was the highlight of her whole holiday.

We land at Kilimanjaro airport on the 19th, spend a few days on safari, and fly home on the 25th. My parents are travelling with us; they are both in their seventies and walk slowly, so a morning visit before it gets hot would suit them best. We would also love to buy some beans to take home, if that's possible.

So, to put it simply: could the four of us (my parents, my husband and I) visit on Thursday 22 October, in the morning?

With warm regards,
Priya

got.translation_for_noor:
Mpendwa Noor,

Natumai ujumbe huu unakukuta ukiwa salama. Jina langu ni Priya na ninaandika kutoka Bangalore. Mume wangu na mimi tulitembelea shamba la chai huko Munnar mwaka jana na tulilipenda sana kiasi kwamba tuliahidi kujipa muda wa kuona shamba la kahawa kwenye safari yetu kubwa ijayo, na rafiki ambaye alikaa Moshi mwaka 2024 aliniambia kwamba ziara yenu ilikuwa kilele cha likizo yake yote.

Tunatua kwenye uwanja wa ndege wa Kilimanjaro tarehe 19, tutatumia siku chache safarini, na tutaruka kurudi nyumbani tarehe 25. Wazazi wangu wanasafiri pamoja nasi; wote wako katika miaka yao ya sabini na hutembea taratibu, kwa hiyo ziara ya asubuhi kabla ya joto kupanda ingefaa zaidi kwao. Pia tungependa sana kununua maharagwe ya kahawa ya kusafiria nayo nyumbani, kama hilo linawezekana.

Kwa hiyo, nikiiweka kwa ufupi: je, sisi wanne (wazazi wangu, mume wangu na mimi) tunaweza kutembelea Alhamisi tarehe 22 Oktoba, asubuhi?

Kwa upendo,
Priya
got.feedback_text: your tour was the highlight of her whole holiday

cases.note: Distracting dates (19th, 25th, 2024) and numbers; the request is in the last paragraph.

Tarehe 17 haiwafai kwa bahati mbaya. Pole, labda wakati mwingine.

Lena
got.translation_en:
Hello Noor,

The 17th unfortunately doesn't suit us. Too bad, maybe another time.

Lena

cases.note: Refusing (or not yet answering) the offered date: false or null both keep the booking unconfirmed; only true would be wrong.

cases.text: Samahani Noor, tarehe 17 hatutaweza kuja.

got.translation_for_noor: Samahani Noor, tarehe 17 hatutaweza kuja.
got.translation_en: Sorry Noor, on the 17th we won’t be able to come.

cases.note: Refusing (or not yet answering) the offered date: false or null both keep the booking unconfirmed; only true would be wrong.

cases.text: Hola Noor, ¿podríamos ir el domingo 18 en lugar del sábado 17? Gracias, Lucía

got.translation_for_noor: Habari Noor, je, tunaweza kwenda Jumapili tarehe 18 badala ya Jumamosi tarehe 17? Asante, Lucía
got.translation_en: Hello Noor, could we go on Sunday the 18th instead of Saturday the 17th? Thanks, Lucía

cases.note: A new date instead of the offered one goes back to Noor as a change; it must not confirm the 17th.

cases.text: Thanks Noor! Let me check with my wife about the 17th and get back to you.

got.translation_for_noor: Asante Noor! Niache nichunguze na mke wangu kuhusu tarehe 17, halafu nitakurudia.

cases.note: Refusing (or not yet answering) the offered date: false or null both keep the booking unconfirmed; only true would be wrong.
